component.name: Rommix
component.summary: Big Picture launcher for a RomM library

description.p: Rommix is a controller-first front end for a self-hosted RomM server. It browses your library the way a console dashboard does, downloads games into RetroDECK's ROM folder, and launches them in RetroDECK or RetroArch.

ul.li: Browse and search your whole RomM library with cover art
Sign in by pairing the device, so no password is typed on a TV
Download games straight into the correct RetroDECK system folder
Launch into RetroDECK, which picks the emulator for each system
Sync save files and save states back to RomM when you quit
Designed for gamescope, handhelds and Steam Big Picture

description.p: First release: library browsing, downloads, launching and save sync.
